name: JSON null is not SQL NULL

name: array lower bounds

name: equivalent CHECK
answer: CREATE TABLE t(id INT CHECK(0<id))

name: unique index NULL semantics
answer: CREATE TABLE t(id INT); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux ON t(id)

name: unique index INCLUDE vs key
